52:7: Indeed, the punishment of your Rabb will surely occur.
52:8: There is no preventer for it.
52:9: The day the sky shakes with shaking.
52:11: Woe on that day to the deniers!
52:12: Those who plunge into vain talk, amusing themselves.
52:13: That day, when they are thrust into the fire of Hell.
52:14: This is the fire that you used to deny.
52:15: Is this magic, or do you not see?
52:16: Enter it; whether you are patient or you are not patient, it is the same for you; you are only being recompensed for what you used to do.
52:17: Indeed, the people of taqwa are in gardens and bliss.
52:18: Rejoicing in what their Rabb has given them, and their Rabb has protected them from the punishment of Hell.
52:19: Eat and drink with pleasure because of what you used to do.
52:20: Reclining on lined-up couches, and We have wedded them to large-eyed houris.
52:21: Those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith; We joined their descendants to them and We did not diminish anything from their deeds. Every person is a pledge for what he earned.
52:22: We provide them abundantly with fruit and meat, whatever they desire.
52:23: There they pass to one another a cup wherein there is no vain talk and no sin.
52:24: And there circulate around them boys belonging to them, as if they were protected pearls.
52:25: Some of them turn to others, asking.
52:26: They said: "Indeed, we were previously fearful among our family."
52:27: Allah favored us and protected us from the scorching punishment.
52:28: Indeed, we previously used to pray to Him. Indeed, He is the Possessor of goodness and Most Merciful.
52:29: Remind, by the favor of your Rabb you are neither a soothsayer nor a madman.
52:30: Or do they say: "He is a poet, we await for him the calamities of time"?
52:31: Say: "Wait, indeed I too am with you among the waiting."
52:32: Or is it their intellects that command them this, or are they a transgressing people?
52:33: Or do they say: "Did he fabricate it?" No, they do not believe.
52:34: If they are truthful, let them bring a discourse similar to it.
52:35: Or were they created without a creator, or are they themselves the creators?
52:36: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? No, they do not believe with certainty.
52:37: Or are the treasures of your Rabb with them, or are they the controllers?
52:38: Or do they have a ladder in which they listen? Then let their listener bring a clear proof.
52:39: Or are the daughters His, and sons yours?
52:40: Or do you ask them for a fee so that they are burdened under a heavy debt?
52:41: Or is the unseen with them so that they are writing?
52:42: Or do they intend to plot a trap? But those who disbelieve are the ones who will fall into the trap.
52:43: Or do they have a deity other than Allah? Allah is transcendent above what they associate as partners.
52:44: And if they were to see a fragment falling from the sky, they would say, 'This is an accumulated cloud.'
52:45: Leave them until their day in which they will be struck down.
52:46: That day, their plot will not benefit them at all, and they will not be helped.
52:47: And indeed, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides this, but most of them do not know.
52:48: Be patient for the judgment of your Rabb, for indeed you are before Our eyes, and glorify your Rabb with praise when you arise.
52:49: And in a part of the night and at the setting of the stars, glorify Him.
